issues: MINOR (testing-only) — Floating OPSI orb (position:absolute right:16 bottom:96 zIndex:1000) overlaps with the 'Bag Jodo' text button in the '4 · BAGS' section header on 390px width. Real users can still tap Bag Jodo (touch resolves to nearest element), but Playwright's .click() on the tiny 50x12 'Bag Jodo' text opens the OPSI modal instead. Fix: give Bag Jodo more padding/hitSlop or add a small right-margin on the Bags section header row so it clears the orb envelope, OR add a testID to Bag Jodo and use element-based selector.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native web console emits deprecation warnings on every screen: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.', 'textShadow* style props are deprecated. Use textShadow.', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking but should be migrated. Reference: /app/frontend/src/lib/opsi-orb.tsx:424-427 (textShadowColor/textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius), :434-438 (shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowRadius/shadowOpacity), :468-472 same; /app/frontend/app/bullion.tsx:776-780 & :1116-1119; and any GlassCard style with shadow*.

Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Fires on OpsiOrb pulse animation (opsi-orb.tsx:128-140 uses useNativeDriver:false already for web, but some other Animated calls elsewhere may still pass true). Non-blocking; JS driver works fine on web preview.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:5953-5976 — Bug 5 ledger DESC sort middleware still active, unchanged from iter87. Sort key falls back date→created_at→'' so undated rows sink to bottom deterministically. Applies to BOTH /api/ledger/entries and /api/ledger/entries?party_id=X because the middleware runs on the response regardless of query params.

date-picker-modal.tsx (whole file) — Zero-dependency implementation. parseIso() safely handles non-ISO input by falling back to new Date(). toIso() pads month/day to 2 digits. Grid useMemo correctly leads with firstDayIdx null cells and pads trailing to a multiple of 7. Selected/today styling is layered correctly (selected wins over today via !isSelected && isToday guards). Modal uses transparent+animationType='fade', Pressable backdrop dismisses, inner Pressable stopPropagation prevents accidental dismiss on card taps. Clean.

bullion.tsx:399-431 — Bug 1 'India Gold (per gram)' card uses correct source keys (sln_bullion.rates.gold_24k_1g_inr / gold_22k_1g_inr / silver_1kg_inr) with Number(...).toLocaleString('en-IN') so values render as ₹15,289/g not ₹15289/g. Card title/subtitle strings match review spec verbatim.

bullion.tsx:468-499 — Bug 1 'Booth Exchange (Bangkok)' card uses grandsuperrich.com subtitle + row labels '1 INR → THB', '1 USD → THB', '1 SGD → THB' with ฿X.XXX (toFixed(3) for INR, toFixed(2) for USD/SGD). Matches review spec.

ledger.tsx:281-302 + :401-412 — Bug 3 balCol has minWidth:110 with alignItems:'flex-end' and marginLeft:4; balAmt (INR) fontSize:14 fontWeight:800 numberOfLines:1 + balSub (THB) fontSize:11 fontWeight:700 marginTop:2 numberOfLines:1 on separate lines. Both use tabular-nums on iOS. Party name column has flex:1 + minWidth:0 so it truncates gracefully instead of pushing the balance column off-screen. Layout is correct for 5+ digit INR values.

opsi-orb.tsx:257-260 + :418-427 — Bug 2 orbLabel Text component is a sibling of the animated orb inside the same Pressable, so the label is part of the tappable hit area. orbHit is 60x76 (up from 60x60) to accommodate the label with marginTop:4. Text color is colors.brand (green) with textShadow for legibility over dark backgrounds. Correct placement below the sparkles icon.

Reusable backend regression: /app/backend/tests/test_iter88_bug_batch.py (extend for future ledger-sort / live-rates label / GSTIN regressions). Known testing gotcha: on 390px viewport, floating OPSI orb (opsi-orb.tsx orbWrap position:absolute right:16 bottom:96 zIndex:1000) can intercept Playwright .click() on small text targets near the bottom-right (e.g. 'Bag Jodo' in shipments/new). Workarounds: (a) request testID from main agent, (b) scroll target above the fold before clicking, or (c) query via [data-testid] instead of text= selector. This is testing-tool-only; real users don't hit it because touch resolves to the nearest element by geometry.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found in this batch. Only observation: Playwright-level selector conflict between OPSI orb overlay and small text buttons in bottom-right quadrant on narrow mobile viewport. Mitigation is a testID attribute on Bag Jodo and bag date buttons (see action_items).
